# Tranzent Limited

> Tranzent is a cargo and freight company specializing in car logistics —
> professional, secure vehicle delivery built to close the trust gap in
> vehicle transportation. Based in Nigeria, servicing all 36 states + FCT.

Tranzent moves vehicles, fleets, and freight with insured precision and
live visibility, so every handover feels less like a shipment and more
like a promise kept. The name fuses "transit" (the discipline of
movement) with "zen" (the peace of mind that movement shouldn't cost
you) — reliable transit, delivered with absolute trust.

## Services

- **Driven Vehicle Transport** — a vetted, insured driver delivers the
  vehicle directly, ideal for fast single-vehicle turnarounds.
- **Open Vehicle Haulage** — standard open-carrier transport for
  everyday vehicles.
- **Enclosed Vehicle Haulage** — fully enclosed, weather-sealed
  transport for premium, exotic, or high-value vehicles.
- **Vehicle Recovery & Towing** — emergency and scheduled towing for
  breakdowns, accidents, or non-running vehicles.
- **Spare Parts Procurement & Delivery** — sourcing and delivery of
  vehicle spare parts.
- **Vehicle Inspection & Document Validation** — pre-purchase and
  logistics-related vehicle inspection and document checks.
- **Vehicle Recovery & Automotive Services** — broader automotive
  recovery and support services.
